$comment: Help links per screen (features adm-3, sh-r2). A screen's `guide` is the step-by-step guide for it; `null` means no guide page exists yet, and the link goes to the product's docs_root (products.json) instead. ⛔ Never write a URL here that does not answer 200 today (CLAUDE.md 2.41): scripts/wp-admin-kit-check.py --live fetches every one.

Measured 2026-09-27: neither product site has a docs section yet (tranzly.io/docs/ and pagebuildersandwich.com/docs/ answer 404) and the knowledge base has no tranzly-plugin or page-builder-sandwich-plugin article, so every guide is null and the docs root is each product's home page. When lane W4 publishes the guides and videos, the change is a URL per row here.
Keys are route ids. A route with no row gets the docs root, so a plugin route added later is never linked to a 404.
